judgment_text:
PRAYER - This Criminal Original Petition is filed under Section 528 of BNSS Act, 2023, calling for the records in Crime No.6 of 2025 on the file of the 1st respondent herein, and quash the proceedings in the same.

ORDER

1. This Criminal Original Petition has been filed seeking for a direction to call for the records in Crime No. 6 of 2025 on the file of the 1st respondent herein and quash the proceedings in the same.

2. When the matter was taken up for hearing today, Mr.Leonard Arul Joseph Selvam, learned Additional Public Prosecutor, who takes notice for the 1st respondent Police, submitted that the investigation in this case has been completed and the final report has also been filed through e-filing in LTN No. 20250001885 C202500009, before the Additional Mahila Court, Egmore, on 29-10-2025.

3. Recording the submission made by the learned Additional Public Prosecutor, this Criminal Original Petition stands closed. Consequently, connected Miscellaneous Petition is closed.
